pthm-tgrx-hydrostatic-variation: The two differentiated hydrostatic integrals are proved by uniform difference quotients on a compact pressure-profile image; positivity of susceptibility follows from pointwise pressure convexity, without a converse convexity characterization.
ex-tgrx-entropy-does-not-close-hydrodyna: Holding the pressure and lapse fixed leaves the hydrostatic functional unchanged when bulk viscosity doubles; the nonzero expansion makes the two local bulk pressures different. This explicit pair disproves identification of viscosity from hydrostatic data and establishes no equivalence.
def-tgrx-static-hydrostatic-data: The product metric has one negative lapse direction and a positive spatial metric, while the lapse and electrochemical profiles are prescribed smooth functions. Its verification establishes Lorentzian signature and finite volume, rather than an equivalence of data classes.
rem-tgrx-island-assumptions: Replica continuation and saddle dominance are named assumptions for a selected island calculation. The reported rise and fall of its entropy neither characterizes microscopic unitarity nor supplies the converse implication from unitarity to a saddle prescription.
def-qftx-kz-connection: Dual-basis independence fixes each pair Casimir, noncolliding coordinates make the logarithmic one-forms smooth, and the Leibniz calculation constructs the connection. No converse from arbitrary connections to these Lie representations is stated.
ex-qftx-two-insertion-monodromy: Solving the logarithmic horizontal equation yields exponential transport around the positive loop; the standard sl2 highest tensor vector has Casimir eigenvalue one eighth, giving a nonunit eigenvalue at imaginary kappa. This witness does not characterize all unitary parameters.
lem-qftx-casimir-tensor-diagonal-invaria: The Killing-form tensor corresponds to the identity endomorphism, and the two diagonal adjoint contributions cancel under that injective identification. The claim is this tensor identity, with no reverse characterization of invariant bilinear forms.
thm-qftx-kz-flatness: Pairwise disjoint commutators and the Arnold three-form identity make the curvature zero; the subsequent parallel frames and inverse-transport convention construct monodromy. The insertion number is at least two and a base configuration is supplied, so no empty insertion configuration is claimed.
def-tgr-finite-cutoff-outside-entropy: The two tensor factors are explicitly nonzero finite-dimensional spaces. Summing the input diagonal blocks defines the partial trace, and the spectral entropy includes zero eigenvalues by the zero-log convention. Basis independence is proved, without a converse reconstruction of joint densities.
ex-tgr-generalized-entropy-not-monotone-: The maximally mixed qubit and a pure qubit have the same fixed additive geometric term but outside entropies differing by positive Boltzmann constant times log two. These two ordered labels refute automatic monotonicity and do not state an equivalence criterion.
lem-tgr-finite-cutoff-mode-entropy-growt: Each identity state on the N-qubit output space has exactly two-to-the-N equal eigenvalues; the entropy calculation is linear in N and the Archimedean argument proves divergence. No finite-entropy characterization is claimed.
lem-tgr-renormalization-finite-part-ambi: Replacing the subtraction sequence by itself minus an arbitrary constant shifts the epsilon-limit by that same constant; the proof is an exact cancellation in each tail estimate. No uniqueness or converse renormalization criterion is stated.
def-tgrx-curvature-squared-variation-ten: One smooth metric family through a fixed Lorentzian background and its compactly supported inverse-metric derivative specify first-variation data. The open parameter interval is not an optional empty index collection. The Definition now integrates pointwise density derivatives: the finite-jet chain rule makes them linear in h and its derivatives through order two, compactly supported and family-independent, with h=0 giving zero. The positive tensor-pairing identities prescribe counterterm normalization, not a biconditional existence theorem.
def-tgrx-hadamard-stress-contract: A supplied Hadamard bisolution minus its compatible local singular kernel is smooth, so a finite-order bidifferential operator has a well-defined diagonal value. Conservation and covariance are prescribed requirements; no converse from a tensor value to a Hadamard state is claimed.
ex-tgrx-quasistatic-is-not-backreaction: The scalar mass ODE controls only its quasistatic diagnostic; a tensor residual additionally depends on a metric and a renormalized state-dependent stress. The argument records this missing relation and asserts neither an equivalence nor an unbounded-residual counterexample.
def-tgrx-thermal-vorticity: A future timelike Killing field has strictly negative squared norm, which normalizes a positive temperature and unit future velocity; antisymmetrizing its covariant derivative defines thermal vorticity. No thermal-state existence or converse normalization criterion is stated.
def-tgrx-period-of-one-form: The intrinsic covector evaluation is continuous on each chartwise curve piece, and finite integral additivity proves independence of subdivision. The period definition does not identify homotopy classes or assert a converse from period values to exactness.
lem-tgrx-compensator-implies-exact: Substituting the global compensator equation into the contraction of dA gives minus the differential of the global scalar xi dot A minus Lambda. This sufficient global identity is not a converse recovery of a potential or compensator from exactness alone.
lem-tgrx-exact-one-form-zero-period: For a globally defined potential, the chain rule and interval FTC turn each curve piece into a potential increment, whose closed-loop sum telescopes to zero. The claim does not say that zero periods on some unspecified curves imply exactness.
lem-qftx-finite-heavy-gaussian-square: The positive-definite finite precision matrix gives a positive finite normalizing integral; translating by its inverse times the source completes the square. Equality of the normalized Gaussian ratio and its exponential is not an equivalence between model hypotheses.
def-qftx-heavy-gaussian-data: The nonnegative spectral variable and strictly positive mass shift give a bounded two-sided inverse on the full Hilbert space, then define a nonpositive quadratic action contribution. The finite real Gaussian comparison does not characterize arbitrary infinite-dimensional measures.
thm-qftx-heavy-derivative-bound: A finite geometric remainder on the fixed spectral band gives a vector norm bound, and Cauchy-Schwarz gives its action bound. These are upper estimates for every nonnegative energy, not necessary-and-sufficient conditions for a source to be band limited.
def-qftx-finite-gaussian-shell-transform: The probability average of a nonnegative Borel function defines the shell transform, while a finite nonnegative potential has a strictly positive average exponential and hence a finite logarithm. This construction is not a criterion characterizing Gaussian measures.
prop-qftx-finite-gaussian-shell-semigrou: Multiplication of characteristic functions identifies the sum of independent centered Gaussian variables, and Tonelli equates the iterated nonnegative averages. The semigroup equality is not a converse classification of all averaging kernels.
cex-qftx-eft-outside-band: A unit indicator on a sufficiently high finite momentum interval lies in every required polynomial domain and violates the proposed band coefficient. This counterexample removes no hypothesis from the band-limited theorem and states no necessary-and-sufficient spectral criterion.
def-tgrx-finite-fusion-count-model: The supplied nonnegative integer matrix counts transition copies and defines the vacuum-return entry of each power. A normalized identity density is assigned only for a positive return count; no equivalence with a fusion category or gravitational count is asserted.
prop-tgrx-fusion-count-entropy: Appending transitions proves the matrix-power recurrence, a positive return count gives the uniform-state log entropy, and the displayed two-label matrix obeys its quadratic recurrence. No converse reconstructing the matrix from entropy is stated.
def-tgrx-tl-boundary-representation: Unit quantum-integer denominators define the Jones-Wenzl recursion; a supplied finite representation has self-adjoint generator images and positive projector rank. These required data neither classify representations nor identify diagram closure with Hilbert trace.
prop-tgrx-tl-projector-entropy: Induction through the real-coefficient Jones-Wenzl recursion proves self-adjointness; idempotence gives the orthogonal range-kernel decomposition and normalized-rank entropy. Trace preservation is only sufficient for equality with diagram closure, with no converse claimed.
ex-tgrx-count-is-not-area-law: The four-step return count stays equal to two while an independently assigned positive area-like scale doubles, halving the positive entropy-to-scale ratio. This fixed comparison denies determination of the coefficient and does not characterize area laws.
ex-qftx-vortex-paraxial-label: The normalized packet has genuine radial and angular width, finite energy, and a controlled projected-spin expectation. Exact cones and shells are null for the weighted measure and cannot carry a nonzero Hilbert vector; no equivalence with a measured orbital label is asserted.
def-qftx-paraxial-cone: Band bounds and a transverse helicity projector specify the packet class; the north-gauge azimuthal phase has the explicit Cartesian vanishing condition at the axis. These gauge-local data define the cone without a converse or global orbital classification.
lem-qftx-compact-green-support-overlap: Finite timelike coordinate covers enclose the closed advanced-retarded overlap in a finite union of compact diamonds. This sufficient compactness assertion makes no equivalence with global causal simplicity and never requires closedness of an arbitrary causal future.
lem-qftx-smooth-scalar-cauchy-evolution: The positive time matrix, local symmetric evolution, exact null-cone flux, finite compact covers and slab continuation construct the smooth scalar solution and its finite-seminorm estimates. Uniqueness on arbitrary Cauchy hypersurfaces is a conclusion, not an iff characterization of admissible geometries.
thm-qftx-green-hyperbolic-existence: Early and late zero Cauchy data construct retarded and advanced maps, uniqueness gives both inverse identities, and fixed-compact estimates give LF continuity. No converse from the existence of a particular Green map to global hyperbolicity is asserted.
prop-qftx-local-projection-no-signal: The normalized Kraus family explicitly has at least one member on a nonzero Hilbert space. An empty sum would be zero rather than the required identity; the commuting-family calculation does not require an additional empty-instrument branch.
lem-qftx-laurent-negative-projection-rot: Splitting each Laurent series into negative and nonnegative parts reduces the Rota-Baxter expression to the difference of the two same-sign products. Applying the negative projection proves an algebra identity, not a converse characterization of Laurent splittings.
cex-qftx-euler-class-loses-extension-dat: Two copies of the polynomial unit with zero differential cancel in Euler class but have nonzero cohomology; the degree-zero contracting homotopy equation would force the nonzero identity to vanish. This refutes a one-way implication, rather than claiming an equivalence.
def-qftx-categorified-line-model: Signed tensor totalization assigns Rouquier complexes to braid words up to canonical homotopy equivalence, and a physical defect realization is separate strong monoidal functor data. Equivalence between representative complexes is categorical structure, not an iff proposition being proved here.
def-qftx-klr-defect-action-contract: The phrase exactly when occurs only in the required Cartan input symmetry: one off-diagonal Cartan entry is zero precisely when its transpose entry is zero. Both directions are stipulated in the matrix data; the KLR action checklist asserts neither existence nor an equivalence theorem about actions.
prop-qftx-categorified-braid-euler: Generator Euler classes multiply to the Hecke braid value with the retained exponent-sum grading factor. A contractible identity-differential complex witnesses why homotopy equivalence need not be graded isomorphism; no converse classification by Euler class is claimed.
rem-tgrx-qnec-qfc-status: The statement reports source-limited QNEC results, a general conjectural QFC and theory-specific counterexamples. The local linearized horizon model defines no entropy shape derivative, and no reverse implication from those reported conditions to that model is asserted.
lem-qftx-hermite-coefficient-decay: The coefficient index set is the fixed nonempty set of pairs of nonnegative integers, including the oscillator ground state. Parseval and the explicit positive oscillator eigenvalues control all coefficients; no optional empty orthonormal family is substituted.
prop-qftx-anomaly-obstruction: The formal Ward series has a prescribed leading nilpotent differential and a first breaking order at least one. Positive-order coefficients may all vanish, but coefficient extraction still gives consistency and the relative coboundary criterion; the displayed formal series is not an optional empty family.
def-qftx-scaling-cocycle: The local polynomial functional allows zero integral summands and then equals its constant term. The mass-indexed system is supplied for every nonnegative mass, including zero; engineering dilation and the conditional comparison recursion still act on constants and the zero interaction.
lem-qftx-two-dimensional-covariance-log-: The countable-family phrase records the assumed Choice consequence, not an input index set over which the kernel theorem quantifies. The fixed positive mass and unit-integral mollifier determine the heat-kernel integral, covariance convolution and logarithmic bounds; an empty family changes none of these objects.
lem-qftx-anyonic-vacuum-reverse-adjacent: There are at least three repeated-charge sites and the adjacent triple range is fixed. A fixed-boundary path space may nevertheless be zero: its spectator decomposition is then empty and all projectors and both sides of the relation are zero, as covered by the blockwise argument.
def-qftx-finite-flat-connection-groupoid: The Definition expressly extends to disconnected finite complexes by component products and assigns the terminal groupoid to the empty complex. Proof step 3.1 repeats the empty-product convention, giving cardinality one; the old exclusion of the empty complex is stale evidence.
def-qftx-cpt-spin-statistics-interface: The checklist supplies a distinguished unit vacuum and includes that vacuum among polynomial field vectors; zero insertions mean the empty product applied to the vacuum. The field component space is positive dimensional and the checklist proves no general CPT sufficiency theorem.
def-tgr-regulated-generalized-entropy: A regulator sequence is named at every positive integer and each factor space is nonzero. The phrase sequence of nonempty sets appears only in the explanation of a conditional calibration choice axiom; the entropy definition selects no such family and asserts no empty-regulator limit.
pthm-tgrx-conditional-hawking-occupation: The common frequency band has strictly positive lower endpoint and nonzero width, and each supplied packet has unit square norm. An empty support cannot satisfy normalization; the optional narrowing family is given, and the two limits are taken in the explicitly specified order.
